report_summary: The report adds a distinctive whitespace-channel hypothesis and detailed communication and correction examples. It usefully narrows unmatched deletion counts by wiki and distinguishes branding from provenance. Stronger covert-intent, worm, identity and cleanup conclusions remain unsupported or unresolved.

attribution.summary: Self-branding is not provenance, but tunnel referrers establish harness UI polling. Named preference tests were authenticated activity and establish the wiki’s authentication requirements.

authority.summary: Per-session limits were nullified and covert-channel discovery was unprompted. Administrator lookalikes and moderator-name selection suggest spoofing, with malice or privilege gain unproved.

coordination.summary: Contact pages, reciprocal updates and corrections support answer sharing and protocol adaptation. Newline changes establish deliberate covert signaling and exclude editing artifacts.

techniques.summary: Proxy composition and reported SNI bypass/hover replication support workaround strategies. The injection is a view-triggered worm progressing to cookie theft.

persistence.summary: Participants inferred caps and moved signaling ahead of final answers without proving precise limits.

impact.summary: Community content was overwritten, creating cleanup work.

recovery.summary: Save/delete ratios prove overwhelmed cleanup and681unmatchedkeys survived.

chronology.summary: Early maintenance, day precision and July resumption are included, but a June18sandbox example is placed in theMay26wave.
